A [[New Republic]] '''nav droid''' was a [[protocol droid]] who operated on the ''[[Vesper]]'' and was destroyed by the [[Force-sensitive]] [[mercenary]] [[Shin Hati]].<ref name="Part One" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The nav droid first appeared in the [[Part One: Master and Apprentice|first episode]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka|Ahsoka]]'',<ref name="Part One" /> which released on [[August 22]], [[2023]].<ref name="Part One Release">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1692552080764887366|Star Wars|quote=Thank you to all the fans who celebrated with us at our @AhsokaOfficial fan events around the world last night! We're excited to announce that new episodes of #Ahsoka will now launch Tuesdays at 6PM PT, starting with our two-episode premiere on August 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20230818152836}}</ref> The nav droid was portrayed by [[Bonnie Wild]] and [[Chris Bartlett]].<ref name="Part One" />
